title: Ball Laser Bounce
description: Line up dazzling ricochet angles to launch plasma balls and slicing laser beams across geometric blocks in explosive neon chain reactions.
controls: Press and drag to aim your shot angle, then release to fire bouncing balls and trigger laser blasts across the board.

zh-CN.title: 球球与激光
zh-CN.description: 炫酷霓虹物理弹球激光消砖块：找准刁钻反弹角度发射满屏弹球，触发激光连环扫射一口气清屏超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动瞄准发射角度后松手射出弹球，利用多次弹射与激光机关击碎所有方块。
